description: Enforced field set and enums for a host-neutral, evidence-bound closure-scope record. Single source read by scripts/validate_closure_scope.py; the prose closure-scope-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (basis_ref non-empty; a NOVEL assertion requires ESTABLISHED_OPEN scope; ESTABLISHED_OPEN requires a field_evidence_ref; no VERIFIED assurance) stay in the validator. Adapts FRR v0.4's calibrated meanings of 'open' to the FRR system's enforced-record model.
